title: Local-first AI infrastructure is becoming a trust and resilience pattern

signal.summary: Local-first AI execution is increasingly relevant for sensitive workflows that need privacy, cost control, and operational continuity.
signal.why_now: Agentic workflows create more opportunities for sensitive data exposure, making local routing and cloud restrictions more important.

context: For public intelligence work, local-first does not mean refusing cloud models. It means routing by data class, risk level, policy, and approval status.
systemic_effects: Sensitive workflows can be routed away from cloud providers.
Cost and token budgets become part of governance.
Public trust improves when AI processing boundaries are explicit.
next_orientation_step: Define which Jazekker workflows must stay local-only and which public, low-risk workflows can use cloud models.
